name: CA3022
description: Low Power Wideband Video Amplifier - Single-stage broadband amplifier for video-rate signals

transfer_function.equation: Vout = gain * Vin, where gain = R2/R1 (set by external resistors)
transfer_function.bandwidth_model: Single dominant pole: H(f) = gain / (1 + j*f/f_3dB)
transfer_function.saturation_model: Soft clip at supply rails: Vout = headroom * tanh(Vin * gain / headroom)

external_components.R1: 5.6 kohm (input resistor - sets gain with R2)
external_components.R2: 10 kohm (feedback resistor - sets gain with R1)

used_in: Paik/Abe Video Synthesizer (Pages 10, 20 - Video output amplifier)
notes: Part of the RCA CA3020 broadband amplifier family (CA3020/CA3021/CA3022/CA3023)
Single gain stage with external feedback network
In Paik/Abe: buffers and amplifies signal after keying/mixing stages
Bandwidth is video-rate (>6 MHz NTSC requirement)

substitutes.notes: Higher power version of same family
